verses.english: Linked Discourses 22.38

verses.pali: 4. Natumhākavagga
verses.english: 4. It’s Not Yours

verses.pali: Dutiyaānandasutta
verses.english: With Ānanda (2nd)

verses.pali: Sāvatthinidānaṁ.
verses.english: At Sāvatthī.

verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho āyasmantaṁ ānandaṁ bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: Sitting to one side, the Buddha said to Ānanda:

verses.pali: “Sace taṁ, ānanda, evaṁ puccheyyuṁ:
verses.english: “Ānanda, suppose they were to ask you:

verses.pali: ‘katamesaṁ, āvuso ānanda, dhammānaṁ uppādo paññāyittha, vayo paññāyittha, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyittha?
verses.english: ‘Reverend Ānanda, what are the things for which arising, vanishing, and change while persisting were evident?

verses.pali: Katamesaṁ dhammānaṁ uppādo paññāyissati, vayo paññāyissati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyissati?
verses.english: What are the things for which arising, vanishing, and change while persisting will be evident?

verses.pali: Katamesaṁ dhammānaṁ uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyatī’ti?
verses.english: What are the things for which arising, vanishing, and change while persisting are evident?’

verses.pali: Evaṁ puṭṭho tvaṁ, ānanda, kinti byākareyyāsī”ti?
verses.english: How would you answer?”

verses.pali: “Sace maṁ, bhante, evaṁ puccheyyuṁ:
verses.english: “Sir, suppose they were to ask me:

verses.pali: ‘katamesaṁ, āvuso ānanda, dhammānaṁ uppādo paññāyittha, vayo paññāyittha, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyittha?
verses.english: ‘Reverend Ānanda, what are the things for which arising, vanishing, and change while persisting were evident?

verses.pali: Katamesaṁ dhammānaṁ uppādo paññāyissati, vayo paññāyissati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyissati?
verses.english: What are the things for which arising, vanishing, and change while persisting will be evident?

verses.pali: Katamesaṁ dhammānaṁ uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyatī’ti?
verses.english: What are the things for which arising, vanishing, and change while persisting are evident?’

verses.pali: Evaṁ puṭṭhohaṁ, bhante, evaṁ byākareyyaṁ:
verses.english: I’d answer like this:

verses.pali: ‘yaṁ kho, āvuso, rūpaṁ atītaṁ niruddhaṁ vipariṇataṁ;
verses.english: ‘Whatever form has passed, ceased, and perished,

verses.pali: tassa uppādo paññāyittha, vayo paññāyittha, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyittha.
verses.english: its arising, vanishing, and change while persisting were evident.

verses.pali: Yā vedanā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā;
verses.english: Whatever feeling …

verses.pali: tassā uppādo paññāyittha, vayo paññāyittha, ṭhitāya aññathattaṁ paññāyittha.
Yā saññā …
verses.english: perception …

verses.pali: ye saṅkhārā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā;
verses.english: choices …

verses.pali: tesaṁ uppādo paññāyittha, vayo paññāyittha, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyittha.
Yaṁ viññāṇaṁ atītaṁ niruddhaṁ vipariṇataṁ;
verses.english: consciousness has passed, ceased, and perished,

verses.pali: tassa uppādo paññāyittha, vayo paññāyittha, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyittha.
verses.english: its arising, vanishing, and change while persisting were evident.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, āvuso, dhammānaṁ uppādo paññāyittha, vayo paññāyittha, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyittha.
verses.english: These the things for which arising, vanishing, and change while persisting were evident.

verses.pali: Yaṁ kho, āvuso, rūpaṁ ajātaṁ apātubhūtaṁ;
verses.english: Whatever form is not yet born, and has not yet appeared,

verses.pali: tassa uppādo paññāyissati, vayo paññāyissati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyissati.
verses.english: its arising, vanishing, and change while persisting will be evident.

verses.pali: Yā vedanā ajātā apātubhūtā;
verses.english: Whatever feeling …

verses.pali: tassā uppādo paññāyissati, vayo paññāyissati, ṭhitāya aññathattaṁ paññāyissati.
Yā saññā …pe…
verses.english: perception …

verses.pali: ye saṅkhārā ajātā apātubhūtā;
verses.english: choices …

verses.pali: tesaṁ uppādo paññāyissati, vayo paññāyissati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyissati.
Yaṁ viññāṇaṁ ajātaṁ apātubhūtaṁ;
verses.english: consciousness is not yet born, and has not yet appeared,

verses.pali: tassa uppādo paññāyissati, vayo paññāyissati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyissati.
verses.english: its arising, vanishing, and change while persisting will be evident.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, āvuso, dhammānaṁ uppādo paññāyissati, vayo paññāyissati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyissati.
verses.english: These are the things for which arising, vanishing, and change while persisting will be evident.

verses.pali: Yaṁ kho, āvuso, rūpaṁ jātaṁ pātubhūtaṁ;
verses.english: Whatever form has been born, and has appeared,

verses.pali: tassa uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyati.
verses.english: its arising, vanishing, and change while persisting is evident.

verses.pali: Yā vedanā jātā pātubhūtā …pe…
verses.english: Whatever feeling …

verses.pali: yā saññā …
verses.english: perception …

verses.pali: ye saṅkhārā jātā pātubhūtā;
verses.english: choices …

verses.pali: tesaṁ uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyati.
Yaṁ viññāṇaṁ jātaṁ pātubhūtaṁ tassa uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyati.
verses.english: consciousness has been born, and has appeared, its arising, vanishing, and change while persisting are evident.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, āvuso, dhammānaṁ uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyatī’ti.
verses.english: These are the things for which arising is evident, vanishing is evident, and change while persisting is evident.’

verses.pali: Evaṁ puṭṭhohaṁ, bhante, evaṁ byākareyyan”ti.
verses.english: That’s how I’d answer such a question.”
